name: Betaine
summary: Studied for strength, power, and body composition.
lead: Betaine, also called trimethylglycine (TMG) or glycine betaine, is a small N-trimethylated amino acid derivative first isolated from sugar beets, after which it is named . It occurs in beets, spinach, quinoa, wheat and seafood, is made in the body from choline, and acts both as a methyl donor in one-carbon metabolism and as an osmolyte that protects cells under stress .
claims: Betaine increases strength and power
Betaine reduces cortisol and prevents overtraining
Betaine promotes cell hydration and volumisation
Betaine HCl and apple cider vinegar help digestion

name: Ashwagandha
summary: Adaptogen with small bumps to strength, stress, and some hormone readings.
lead: Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera), also called Indian ginseng or winter cherry, is an evergreen shrub of the nightshade family whose root powder has been used for centuries in traditional Indian medicine . It is sold as a dietary supplement as root or leaf powder or standardized extracts, marketed as an adaptogen for stress, sleep, vitality, strength and testosterone .
claims: Ashwagandha boosts testosterone
Ashwagandha lowers stress and cortisol
Ashwagandha improves sleep
Ashwagandha builds strength and recovery

name: Turkesterone
summary: Hyped ecdysteroid marketed as anabolic. Human evidence is weak.
lead: Turkesterone is a naturally occurring phytoecdysteroid, a plant steroid related to the molting hormones of insects, found in Ajuga turkestanica and several other plants, including Vitex species, Cyanotis arachnoidea, wheat and Rhaponticum acaule . It is sold as a dietary supplement and promoted to bodybuilders as a natural anabolic, often described by sellers as an alternative to anabolic steroids .
claims: Turkesterone is a natural anabolic stronger than Dianabol
It builds muscle without suppressing your natural hormones
Turkesterone raises SHBG
Turkesterone does nothing; influencers profit from hype

name: Ecdysterone
summary: Plant/insect steroid with early hypertrophy signals. Preliminary.
lead: Ecdysterone, more formally 20-hydroxyecdysone (20E), is a naturally occurring ecdysteroid hormone that controls molting and metamorphosis in insects and crustaceans; it is also produced by plants such as Cyanotis vaga, Ajuga turkestanica and Rhaponticum carthamoides, where it is thought to defend against herbivores . Spinach and quinoa are listed among dietary sources .
claims: Ecdysterone is an anabolic that rivals prohibited steroids
It works through estrogen receptor beta, not androgen receptors
Product quality matters: many supplements are underdosed
Ecdysterone is a way to improve hormone balance without raising testosterone

name: Testosterone
summary: The androgen. Muscle protein synthesis, bone density, male secondary characteristics.
lead: Testosterone is the principal male sex hormone and an androgen, a steroid hormone made mainly by the testicles in males and in smaller amounts by the ovaries in females. It drives the development of male reproductive tissues and secondary sexual characteristics, including increases in muscle and bone mass, body hair growth, voice deepening and remodelling of the jaw, brow and facial bone contours at puberty, and it also influences mood, libido, red blood cell production and metabolism.
claims: TRT is a legitimate long-term treatment that restores wellbeing in men with diagnosed low testosterone
Testosterone amplifies a man's existing traits ('a multiplier') rather than creating new ones
Supraphysiologic testosterone reliably builds muscle in healthy men
TRT is compatible with 'natural' bodybuilding and attainable without drugs at supraphysiologic levels

name: Somatropin
summary: Growth hormone. Drives IGF-1 signaling and body-composition change.
lead: Somatropin is recombinant human growth hormone (rhGH or HGH), a biosynthetic form of the pituitary hormone whose amino acid sequence matches the natural hormone. It is prescribed to treat growth hormone deficiency in children and adults, and several other conditions involving growth failure or body-composition change, and it has been approved by the US Food and Drug Administration for these uses since the mid-1980s.
claims: HGH use adds to a 'steroid look' and contributes to jaw and facial width
HGH is a safe anti-ageing and muscle-building therapy for healthy adults
GH combined with insulin and anabolic steroids is an especially effective stack
Gray-market HGH is available at stable prices and is genuine

name: MK-677
summary: Oral ghrelin agonist that raises GH and IGF-1 (and hunger). No proven aesthetic benefit.
lead: MK-677, also known as ibutamoren (developmental codes MK-0677, L-163,191 and, in more recent development, LUM-201), is an orally active, non-peptide drug that mimics the hormone ghrelin. By activating the ghrelin receptor (GHS-R1a) in the pituitary and hypothalamus, it raises growth hormone (GH) and insulin-like growth factor 1 (IGF-1) levels and also raises cortisol and appetite. It was developed by Merck in the 1990s and has never been approved for any indication; it remains an investigational compound.
claims: MK-677 raises GH/IGF-1 and improves recovery, joints and body composition
It is a good bulking aid because it makes you ravenous
MK-677 can be stacked with testosterone or SARMs to protect muscle on a cycle
MK-677 is a SARM

name: CJC-1295
summary: GHRH analogue that pushes growth hormone release. Limited human endocrine data.
lead: CJC-1295 is a synthetic analogue of growth hormone-releasing hormone (GHRH, also called growth hormone-releasing factor) developed by ConjuChem Biotechnologies. In its best-known form, CJC-1295 with a 'drug affinity complex' (DAC), the peptide attaches to the blood protein albumin, which extends its half-life to roughly six to eight days and allows a single injection to raise growth hormone (GH) and insulin-like growth factor 1 (IGF-1) for days. A shorter-acting version without the DAC, often called 'modified GRF (1-29)', is a separate compound, though the two are sometimes confused.
claims: CJC-1295 safely restores youthful GH and IGF-1 levels
CJC-1295 speeds recovery from tendon and other injuries
Stacking CJC-1295 with GHRP-6 or ipamorelin produces greater GH release than either alone
CJC-1295 helps women with fat loss, skin and sleep

name: Ipamorelin
summary: Selective GH secretagogue; thin human data.
lead: Ipamorelin (development code NNC 26-0161) is a synthetic pentapeptide that stimulates the release of growth hormone (GH) by acting as a selective agonist at the ghrelin receptor, also called the growth hormone secretagogue receptor. It was derived from the earlier compound GHRP-1 and originally developed by Novo Nordisk in the 1990s.
claims: Ipamorelin and other GH secretagogues can add height while growth plates are open.
CJC-1295 with ipamorelin improves sleep quality and facial bone growth.
A user who bought ipamorelin and CJC-1295 as a teenager later saw an endocrinologist instead and was glad not to have used them.
MK-677 is better than CJC-1295 with ipamorelin.

name: Sermorelin
summary: GHRH analogue stimulating your own GH release. Hormonal mechanism is real; cosmetic benefit unproven.
lead: Sermorelin (sermorelin acetate; brand names Geref and Gerel) is a synthetic peptide made of the first 29 amino acids of human growth hormone-releasing hormone (GHRH), thought to be the shortest fully active fragment of the natural 44-amino-acid hormone. It binds the GHRH receptor on the pituitary gland and prompts release of the body's own growth hormone (GH).
claims: Sermorelin with MK-677 can add height in a teenager with open growth plates.
Sermorelin keeps users leaner and can act as an anti-ageing treatment.
Sermorelin improves sleep and joint comfort.
Sermorelin does not work in men over 60.

name: GHRP-6
summary: GH secretagogue that also makes you ravenous.
lead: GHRP-6 (growth hormone-releasing peptide 6, developmental code SKF-110679) is a synthetic hexapeptide with the sequence His-D-Trp-Ala-Trp-D-Phe-Lys-NH2. It belongs to a family of met-enkephalin analogues containing unnatural D-amino acids that lack opioid activity but strongly stimulate growth hormone (GH) release, and it was the first hexapeptide extensively studied in humans.

name: IGF-1 LR3
summary: Modified IGF-1 analogue sold for muscle growth. No reliable human evidence.
lead: IGF-1 LR3 (long arginine 3 insulin-like growth factor 1, also written LR3-IGF-1 or Long R3 IGF-1) is a synthetic, lengthened analogue of human insulin-like growth factor 1 (IGF-1). It differs from the natural hormone by an arginine in place of glutamic acid at position 3 and an extra 13 amino acids at the N-terminus, giving a protein of 83 amino acids compared with 70 for native IGF-1.
claims: IGF-1 LR3 is an 'anabolic powerhouse' for muscle growth and healing
Injecting it into a muscle produces localised growth, and may cause permanent 'bloat'
IGF-1 LR3 can be stacked with insulin and steroids for greater effect
It cannot be detected in a drug test

name: Follistatin-344
summary: The myostatin-blocker dream. Experimental only.
lead: Follistatin-344 (often written FS-344) is the label under which unapproved, injectable preparations of the protein follistatin are sold by peptide vendors, mainly to people interested in building muscle. Follistatin itself is a secreted glycoprotein encoded by the FST gene in humans; it binds and neutralizes members of the transforming growth factor-beta (TGF-beta) superfamily, notably activin and myostatin (also called GDF-8), a protein that limits muscle growth.
claims: Injected FS-344 works as a myostatin inhibitor that adds muscle beyond natural limits
Follistatin is what produces extreme muscularity in some athletes
Blocking myostatin and activin with follistatin is safe because it is a natural protein
Cocoa, certain foods and training raise follistatin and therefore build muscle

name: Ostarine
summary: The most-studied SARM; never approved. Suppresses your own hormones.
lead: Ostarine, known in the medical literature as enobosarm and by the code names GTx-024, MK-2866 and S-22, is an orally taken, nonsteroidal selective androgen receptor modulator (SARM). Developed to treat muscle wasting, it was tested in cancer cachexia, sarcopenia and other conditions, and it is not approved as a medicine for any use. The name Ostarine was a tentative brand name chosen by its developer, GTx, Inc., that was never used commercially but persists as a synonym; enobosarm is the International Nonproprietary Name.
claims: Ostarine is the least harmful or least suppressive SARM
Ostarine gives near-steroid results for aesthetics without liver stress
Ostarine can be added to TRT or used to help recovery after steroid cycles
Ostarine burns fat in the midsection

name: LGD-4033
summary: SARM; lean mass gains in small trials, hormonal suppression in practice.
lead: LGD-4033, also called Ligandrol and by the developmental code VK5211, is an orally taken, nonsteroidal selective androgen receptor modulator (SARM) originally developed by Ligand Pharmaceuticals. It has been studied for muscle atrophy, including after hip fracture, and was also explored for cachexia, hypogonadism and osteoporosis; it is not approved for any medical use.
claims: LGD-4033 is a safer, non-suppressive way to gain lean mass compared with steroids
LGD-4033 produces large lean mass gains in a few weeks
LGD-4033 damages cholesterol even at low doses
Products sold as Ligandrol are often not what they claim to be

name: RAD-140
summary: Potent SARM with liver and hormone risks. Insufficient evidence it is safe.
lead: RAD-140, whose International Nonproprietary Name is vosilasarm and which is also called RAD140, EP0062 and by the black-market name Testolone, is an orally taken, nonsteroidal selective androgen receptor modulator (SARM). It was developed by Radius Health in 2010, first described in the literature in 2011, and is now under development by Ellipses Pharma for androgen receptor-positive, estrogen receptor-negative, HER2-negative advanced breast cancer. Earlier plans to develop it for sarcopenia, osteoporosis and cancer cachexia were discontinued.
claims: RAD-140 builds muscle and burns fat with few side effects
RAD-140 is safe for liver and heart at the doses people use
RAD-140 suppresses less testosterone than steroids
RAD-140 helps with recovery or restoring libido after a cycle

name: YK-11
summary: Marketed as a myostatin-inhibiting SARM. No reliable human evidence.
lead: YK-11 is a synthetic steroidal compound that is usually classed as a selective androgen receptor modulator (SARM). Wikipedia describes it as a gene-selective partial agonist of the androgen receptor that does not trigger the N/C interaction normally needed for full receptor activation, and as having anabolic activity in cultured C2C12 myoblasts greater than that of dihydrotestosterone (DHT). It has been investigated in animal studies of sepsis-induced muscle wasting and has appeared on the market as a designer drug.
claims: YK-11 is a myostatin inhibitor that builds muscle beyond ordinary SARMs
YK-11 is really a steroid, not a SARM
YK-11 delivers noticeable gains
All SARMs, including YK-11, can be safely stacked

name: Finasteride
summary: Blocks DHT (type II 5-AR). The proven hair-loss stopper.
lead: Finasteride, sold under brand names including Proscar and Propecia, is an oral medication used to treat male pattern hair loss (androgenetic alopecia) and benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH). It is a 5-alpha-reductase inhibitor, an antiandrogen that lowers production of dihydrotestosterone (DHT) by about 70 percent in serum and 65 to 70 percent in scalp skin, according to Wikipedia. The US label describes it as a competitive and specific inhibitor of type II 5-alpha-reductase and indicates the 1 mg hair-loss product for men only.
claims: Finasteride is the proven way to stop hair loss
Lower or topical doses keep the benefit with fewer sides
Finasteride can cause lasting sexual and mood problems (post-finasteride syndrome)
Side effects are not worth it

name: Dutasteride
summary: Blocks both 5-AR isoenzymes — stronger DHT suppression than finasteride.
lead: Dutasteride, sold as Avodart among other brands, is an oral medication that inhibits 5-alpha-reductase, the enzyme that converts testosterone to dihydrotestosterone (DHT). It is FDA-approved for symptomatic benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH) and is used off-label for male pattern hair loss in most countries; it is approved for male androgenetic alopecia at 0.5 mg per day in South Korea (2009), Japan (2015) and Taiwan (2016), according to Wikipedia.
claims: Dutasteride is stronger than finasteride and should be tried first
Topical dutasteride avoids the side effects of the oral drug
Dutasteride can cause lasting impotence or hormonal damage
Dutasteride raises testosterone more than finasteride

name: Minoxidil
summary: Grows hair and extends the growth phase. Topical is OTC; low-dose oral is Rx.
lead: Minoxidil, sold as Rogaine and Loniten among other brands, is a vasodilator medication used for high blood pressure and for hair loss. Taken orally at high doses it treats severe hypertension, while topical minoxidil, available over the counter as a solution or foam, is used for androgenetic alopecia, and low-dose oral minoxidil is prescribed off-label for hair loss. Topical 2 percent solution and 5 percent solution and foam are FDA-approved for androgenetic alopecia, and oral minoxidil is not FDA-approved for hair loss.
claims: Minoxidil regrows and thickens hair independent of hormones
Oral minoxidil works better than topical and is easier to stick with
Low-dose oral minoxidil does not affect blood pressure
Early shedding means it is working

name: Bimatoprost
summary: Prostaglandin analogue approved for eyelash growth.
lead: Bimatoprost is a synthetic prostamide, a structural analogue of prostaglandin F2-alpha, applied to the eye or eyelid margin. It is sold as Lumigan and generics for open-angle glaucoma and ocular hypertension, and as Latisse for eyelash hypotrichosis . The US Food and Drug Administration approved it for glaucoma in 2001 .
claims: Latisse grows longer, curlier lashes with few side effects.
Latisse can change eye colour, a concern for users with light eyes.
Bimatoprost reduces fat around the eye, which can reshape the eyelid.
Careprost is the same drug as Latisse.

name: Pyrilutamide
summary: Topical androgen-receptor blocker developed for hair loss. Trial results mixed.
lead: Pyrilutamide, developmental code KX-826, is a nonsteroidal androgen receptor antagonist designed for topical use in androgenetic alopecia (pattern hair loss) and acne. It is being developed by Suzhou Kintor Pharmaceuticals . Wikipedia describes it as a high-affinity, selective silent antagonist of the androgen receptor .
claims: Pyrilutamide is a topical anti-androgen that works like RU58841 for hair
A topical anti-androgen cannot cause systemic side effects

name: RU58841
summary: Gray-market topical antiandrogen. No established human safety profile.
lead: RU58841, also known as PSK-3841 or HMR-3841, is a nonsteroidal antiandrogen originally developed by the French company Roussel Uclaf. It was later investigated by ProStrakan (earlier ProSkelia and Strakan) as a topical treatment for androgen-dependent conditions including acne, pattern hair loss and excess hair growth . It is structurally related to nilutamide and other nonsteroidal antiandrogens .
claims: RU58841 is a potent topical anti-androgen that may be safer than finasteride because it acts locally
Many hair-loss forum users have had success with it
It works only if applied every day and in a suitable vehicle

name: Biotin
summary: Essential for hair and nail biology.
lead: Biotin, also called vitamin B7 or vitamin H, is a water-soluble B vitamin that serves as a cofactor for five human carboxylase enzymes involved in fatty acid, glucose and amino acid metabolism . It is found in foods such as organ meats and egg yolks, and is sold as a dietary supplement alone or in multivitamins, commonly in doses of 1 to 10 mg marketed for hair and nail health .
claims: Biotin supports healthy hair and hair growth.
Biotin and collagen reduce bloating or water retention.
High-dose biotin interferes with thyroid hormones.
Large amounts of raw egg whites can cause biotin deficiency.

name: Saw palmetto
summary: Botanical DHT blocker. Much weaker than finasteride.
lead: Saw palmetto (Serenoa repens) is a small palm native to the subtropical southeastern United States and Mexico. Extracts of its berries are sold as supplements for prostate symptoms and, increasingly, for hair loss . It is among the botanical products promoted as natural DHT blockers because extracts have antiandrogenic properties in laboratory studies .

name: Pumpkin seed oil
summary: Small studies in pattern hair loss. Preliminary.
lead: Pumpkin seed oil is a dark green to reddish culinary oil pressed from pumpkin seeds, associated especially with Styria in southeastern Austria and neighbouring parts of central and eastern Europe, and now also sold as an oral supplement and topical hair product . It is rich in polyunsaturated fatty acids and contains phytosterols, tocopherols and squalene .
claims: Pumpkin seed oil can regrow hair in male pattern baldness
The 2014 study does not isolate pumpkin seed oil because it was a multi-ingredient supplement
Pumpkin seed oil is a 'cope' next to approved hair-loss treatments

name: Collagen peptides
summary: Supplies amino acids; hydration benefits possible.
lead: Collagen peptides, also called hydrolysed collagen or collagen hydrolysate, are short chains of amino acids produced by enzymatically breaking down animal collagen, usually from bovine, porcine or marine sources. They are sold as powders, drinks and capsules for skin, hair, nails, joints and bone. Collagen itself is a family of structural proteins that make up much of the extracellular matrix of connective tissue, rich in glycine, proline and hydroxyproline .
claims: Mega-dosing collagen peptides (100-140 g a day) visibly improves skin
Collagen supplements are a 'cope' for skin
Collagen peptides taken with vitamin C support tendons and connective tissue
Collagen peptides are a cheaper substitute for bone broth

name: Melatonin (topical)
summary: Studied for follicle cycling and antioxidant effects on the scalp.
lead: Melatonin is an indoleamine hormone best known for regulating the sleep-wake cycle. It was discovered in 1958 by Aaron Lerner and colleagues, who isolated it from bovine pineal gland as a substance that lightened frog skin . It acts on MT1 and MT2 receptors and also works as an antioxidant . Human skin and hair follicles express melatonin receptors and synthesise melatonin themselves, which is the rationale for applying it to the scalp .

name: Vitamin D
summary: Deficiency is linked to some hair-loss conditions and weak bones.
lead: Vitamin D is a group of fat-soluble secosteroid compounds, chiefly vitamin D3 (cholecalciferol) and vitamin D2 (ergocalciferol), whose best-established role is increasing intestinal absorption of calcium and supporting bone health . It is only conditionally essential in the diet, because the skin can synthesise cholecalciferol when exposed to ultraviolet B (UVB) light; it is also obtained from oily fish, egg yolks, fortified foods such as milk and cereals, and supplements .
claims: Vitamin D levels should be tested in winter and high doses used to correct low results
Vitamin D3 should be taken together with K2 (MK-7)
Vitamin D supplementation does nothing during puberty
Vitamin D raises LH, FSH and testosterone

name: Iron
summary: Correcting deficiency can stop deficiency-related shedding.
lead: Iron is an essential mineral (chemical symbol Fe) needed for oxygen transport in haemoglobin and myoglobin, for energy production, for DNA synthesis and for many enzymes . About 65 to 70 percent of the roughly 3 to 4 grams of iron in the human body is bound in haemoglobin . In nutrition and appearance discussions the word refers to dietary iron and oral or intravenous iron supplements rather than the metal itself, which is the subject of the general encyclopedia article .
